hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian crossing infrastructure

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond parked cars.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings at the nearest intersections to clearly define pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting trees along the curb would provide a physical buffer, shade, and a sense of enclosure that naturally slows traffic.

interventions.title: Intersection daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Ensure that household items like bins and boxes are kept clear of the primary walking path to maintain ADA accessibility.

interventions.title: Tree Pit Expansion/Reconfiguration
interventions.description: Reconfigure the area around the tree to ensure a minimum 4-foot clear walking path is maintained.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near intersections or midblock crossing points to improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune the overhanging tree to ensure a clear vertical path for pedestrians and maintain sightlines.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Greenery
interventions.description: Replace the dirt buffer strip with street trees or bioswales to provide a physical barrier, improve aesthetics, and naturally slow traffic speeds.

interventions.title: Street Furniture/Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a designated furniture or planting zone to separate the walking path from the curb, providing a space for trash collection that does not block the sidewalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian demand is high, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage to provide a legal and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming to reduce vehicle speeds to residential limits.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a safety buffer.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or other vertical deflection measures to slow traffic in this residential setting.

interventions.title: Pavement Marking Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint lane lines to improve driver awareness and lane discipline.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a marked midblock crossing with appropriate signage to provide a designated space for crossing.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to provide designated areas for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.
